---
name: Class Proposal
about: Propose a new crash class for the model to detect
title: "[CLASS PROPOSAL] "
labels: class-proposal
assignees: ''
---

## Proposed Class Name
e.g., `BUS_RAVINE`

## Description
What type of crash/accident does this class represent?

## Visual Signature
What does this look like from satellite altitude? Describe the visual patterns, colours, shapes, and scale.

## Why Existing Classes Don't Cover This
Explain why current classes are insufficient.

## Sample Images
You must provide at least **50 satellite images** showing examples of this class. Link to a shared folder or attach them.

## Suggested Search Radius
What geographic radius should be used for news cross-referencing? (e.g., 100km)

## Additional Notes
Any other context — data sources, frequency of occurrence, regional specificity, etc.
